hook: Climate talks just failed. First since 2009
caption:
🌍 COP31 ended with no deal, a first since 2009. Paris Agreement and past pledges still stand.
🛡️ NATO's top body meets Monday after Russian missiles landed in Poland.
🔥 Iranian attack hit an industrial site in Bahrain; two people hurt. Hormuz talks still stalled.
🚔 At least 11 dead around the arrest of cartel boss El Chapo Isidro in Mexico.
🪐 BepiColombo is now orbiting Mercury after an eight-year trip.
Should climate summits keep going without a deal? Tell us below 👇
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

1/5 COP31 ends with no deal (2009)
COP31 in Turkey ended Sunday without any final agreement. First failed UN climate deal since Copenhagen in 2009.

2/5 NATO meets over Poland missiles (Kh-101)
NATO's top body meets Monday over Russian missiles in Poland. Rutte pledged in Warsaw to defend Polish territory.
📷 Major Ofer, Israeli Air Force רס"ן עופר, חיל האוויר הישראלי (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Iran strikes Bahrain site (2 hurt)
An Iranian attack hit an industrial site in Bahrain's Sitra. Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.

At least 11 died in El Chapo Isidro's arrest and aftermath. US charged him in 2012 over fentanyl, cocaine, heroin.

5/5 Probe reaches Mercury orbit (8 yrs)
BepiColombo entered orbit around Mercury after an eight-year trip. Only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury.
